assertion.statement: At an actual derivative prime with nonzero finite localization of the rank-one generic actual class, switching from finite to singular condition produces a generic kernel spanned by its actual derivative and preserves the valuation of the class-functional determinant coordinate.
assertion.objects: The actual split derivative local model D0 plus(F plus S)[−1] plus D2[−2], its retained pairing, and the strict/relaxed/finite/singular Selmer cone complexes.
assertion.hypotheses: The old actual class spans generic H1 and localizes to nonzero v; its actual derivative has finite coordinate0 and singular coordinateJv. Retained integral local pairings/isotropy homotopies and exact global duality/localization identities are supplied.
assertion.quantifiers: At each new inert derivative prime in the finite sequence, over the stated fraction or test field.
assertion.parameter_range: Finite and singular planes of rank2; localization v may be divisible in the integral lattice.
assertion.uniformity: The comparison preserves valuation at every allowed switch, without requiring a uniform divisibility bound on v.
assertion.constants: The common strict determinant factor, including all strict torsion, is retained on both sides; exterior-volume changes are units.
assertion.normalizations: Every condition retains D0; relaxed means D0 plus(F plus S)[−1], not the full local complex. Cross pairing is epsilon times <x,Jy>. Fractional complements are chosen to have unit exterior volume.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Do not require the complement of a divisible v to be integral. Exact annihilator follows from duality/localization, not isotropy alone. The derivative must be the actual class, not a substituted primitive vector.
assertion.limit_order: Retain the integral local model and triangles; pass to the specified test field; identify strict H1 and the relaxed annihilator; use the actual derivative; compare determinant lines with their common strict factor.
